heading.en: Birth and years as a deputy

body.zh-Hant: 夏爾·德布羅克維爾1860年12月4日生於波斯泰爾，1940年卒於布魯塞爾。他出身坎皮納地區的大地主家族，在蒂倫豪特選區當了十八年的眾議院議員，直到1910年才第一次入閣，政治上算大器晚成。
body.en: Charles de Broqueville was born on 4 December 1860 at Postel and died in Brussels in 1940. He came from a family of large landowners in the Campine and sat in the Chamber of Representatives for the Turnhout district for eighteen years before first joining a government in 1910, making him a late bloomer in politics.

Lebensdaten 1860 – 1940

heading.en: Minister of Railways and the premiership

body.zh-Hant: 1910年9月5日，他在舒勒爾特內閣出任鐵路大臣；評論指出，他在受命入閣時有所猶豫。1911年，天主教單一政黨內閣因初等教育補助方式的爭議倒台，德布羅克維爾接任首相。舒勒爾特在這場教育問題上與國王阿爾貝發生衝突。據德國國家圖書館權威檔，他在1911至1918年任首相，其中1912至1917年同時兼任戰爭大臣。
body.en: On 5 September 1910 he became Minister of Railways in the Schollaert cabinet; a reviewer notes that he hesitated when asked to join the government. In 1911 the homogeneous Catholic cabinet fell over how to subsidise primary education, and Broqueville succeeded as prime minister; Schollaert had clashed with King Albert on the school question. According to the German National Library authority record he was prime minister in 1911-1918 and, in 1912-1917, also minister of war.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰時政府與國王的角力
heading.en: The wartime government and the struggle with the King

body.zh-Hant: 第一次世界大戰期間，比利時政府設在勒阿弗爾。1915年7月，歐仁·貝延斯獲任命為外交大臣，此事牽涉國王阿爾貝與政府首腦德布羅克維爾之間的權力鬥爭；1916年1月，在野黨領袖獲任命為正式部長，進入內閣。1917年，國王任命德塞尼克將軍為戰爭大臣；1918年1月，內閣又作調整。
body.en: During the First World War the Belgian government sat at Le Havre. Eugène Beyens was appointed foreign minister in July 1915, an affair bound up with the power struggle between King Albert and the head of government, Charles de Broqueville; in January 1916 opposition leaders were appointed full ministers and entered the cabinet. In 1917 the King appointed General De Ceuninck minister of war, and in January 1918 the cabinet was reshuffled.

body.zh-Hant: 德國國家圖書館權威檔另載他在1932至1934年再度出任首相。他於1940年9月5日去世；亨利·哈格（Henri Haag）的兩卷專著以他自1910年入閣起至逝世為止的政治生涯為主軸，書評稱此書是研究他的參考之作。
body.en: The German National Library authority record also lists him as prime minister again in 1932-1934. He died on 5 September 1940; Henri Haag's two-volume monograph centres on his political career from his entry into government in 1910 until his death, and a reviewer calls it a reference work for anyone researching him.

people.name: Isaías Medina Angarita
people.nameZh: 伊薩亞斯·梅迪納·安加里塔

body.zh-Hant: 伊薩亞斯·梅迪納·安加里塔1897年7月6日生於塔奇拉州的聖克里斯托瓦爾，父親是科羅出身的將軍何塞·羅森多·梅迪納。他1912年3月9日進入加拉加斯的陸軍軍校，1914年7月23日以少尉畢業，1917年4月7日晉升上尉；1919年2月3日回到軍校，擔任學員連連長並兼任教師。
body.en: Isaías Medina Angarita was born on 6 July 1897 in San Cristóbal, Táchira, the son of General José Rosendo Medina from Coro. He entered the Military School in Caracas on 9 March 1912, graduated as a sub-lieutenant on 23 July 1914 and was promoted captain on 7 April 1917; on 3 February 1919 he returned to the school as commander of the cadet company and as a teacher.

heading.en: Teaching and staff service at the War Ministry

body.zh-Hant: 1927年1月15日他已是中校，在軍官候補生學校等校任教。1931年起，他先後任參謀部臨時助理、戰爭與海軍部辦公室主任兼秘書，這個職務做到1935年7月12日。據另一部百科，他曾率領軍事代表團前往厄瓜多（1930年）與美國（1940年）。
body.en: By 15 January 1927 he was a lieutenant colonel and taught at schools including the school for officer candidates. In 1931 he served as interim aide at the General Staff and then as head of the cabinet office and secretary of the Ministry of War and Marine, a post he held until 12 July 1935. Another encyclopedia adds that he led military delegations to Ecuador (1930) and the United States (1940).

heading.zh-Hant: 戰爭與海軍部長與總統候選人
heading.en: Minister of War and Marine and presidential candidate

body.zh-Hant: 1936年3月1日，他經行政命令被任命為戰爭與海軍部長；另一部百科稱他在1936年短暫擔任戰爭部長。1940年7月5日他晉升准將，並為參選總統轉入待命。他的候選人身分於1941年3月3日在聖卡洛斯公開宣布，1941年4月28日國會投票選他為總統，得120票。
body.en: On 1 March 1936 he was appointed Minister of War and Marine by executive decree; another encyclopedia says he served briefly as minister of war in 1936. He became a brigadier general on 5 July 1940 and went on reserve status to run for the presidency. His candidacy was launched at San Carlos on 3 March 1941, and on 28 April 1941 Congress elected him president with 120 votes.

heading.zh-Hant: 總統任期、被推翻與逝世

body.zh-Hant: 梅迪納1941年5月5日就任總統。他任內讓女性首次取得市議員的選舉權與被選舉權，並使共產黨合法化；另有百科記他推出首部所得稅法、與哥倫比亞及英國談妥邊界問題，並於1943年出任自創政黨委內瑞拉民主黨的領導人。1945年10月18日，他被軍民政變推翻，1953年9月15日在加拉加斯去世。
body.en: Medina took office as president on 5 May 1941. In his term women first obtained the right to vote and stand in municipal council elections and the Communist Party was legalised; another encyclopedia credits him with the first income tax law, with border settlements with Colombia and Britain, and with heading his own Venezuelan Democratic Party in 1943. On 18 October 1945 a civilian-military coup overthrew him, and he died in Caracas on 15 September 1953.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身、學歷與從政前經歷

body.zh-Hant: 埃利·萊斯科1883年生於海地的北聖路易，在海地角受教育，後來取得魁北克拉瓦爾大學的博士學位。據百科條目，他此後曾任公共教育、司法與內政方面的部門秘書，也當過駐多明尼加共和國的特使，並在美國擔任外交人員。
body.en: Élie Lescot was born in 1883 in Saint-Louis-du-Nord, Haiti, was educated in Cap-Haïtien and later took a doctorate at Laval University in Quebec. According to the encyclopedia entry he afterwards served as secretary of public education, justice and the interior, as envoy to the Dominican Republic and as a diplomat in the United States.

heading.en: Character of the regime and ties with the United States

body.zh-Hant: 萊斯科的統治期間為1941至1946年，作者稱其政權以暴政與貪腐著稱，並與美國政府及企業界密切合作。他沒收了境內德國人與義大利人的財產，並中止海地憲法；戰時美國的軍事與經濟援助大量湧入。由美國控制的機構出資的瓊麻（sisal）種植計畫，導致數以千計農民被迫遷離。
body.en: Lescot ruled in 1941-1946, and the author describes his regime as known for tyranny and corruption and for close cooperation with US government and business interests. He confiscated the property of Germans and Italians in the country and suspended the Haitian constitution; a large influx of US military and economic aid arrived during the war. A sisal-growing project financed by a US-controlled body led to the displacement of thousands of peasants.

body.zh-Hant: 萊斯科把黑人排除於政府要職之外，並支持天主教會反對伏都教的運動。他修改憲法以延長任期，並推遲選舉。1945年底，學生、工人與知識分子公開要求終結獨裁；1946年革命後，他於1946年1月11日被迫辭職，流亡加拿大。
body.en: Lescot excluded blacks from important government posts and supported the Roman Catholic Church's campaign against the vodun religion. He altered the constitution to extend his term and postponed elections. By the end of 1945 students, workers and intellectuals openly demanded an end to the dictatorship; after the Revolution of 1946 he was forced to resign on 11 January 1946 and went into exile in Canada.
